_comment: Copy for the attract-mode public-service card. build.mjs INLINES this at build time - it is not fetched at runtime, because the shipped artifact must stay a single self-contained file (the CSP blocks external requests, and fetch() on a file:// page is blocked by CORS). Edit here, then run: node build.mjs
_charset: The 5x7 bitmap font covers uppercase A-Z, 0-9, space, and . , : ; ! ? $ + - / % # ( ) [ ] * = < > ' " _ & @ ^ ~ - build.mjs fails the build on anything else, naming the offending characters. Watch for curly quotes from pasted text. Copy is drawn uppercase whatever you type.
_widths: slogan draws at scale 2, max 31 characters per line. attribution and credit draw at scale 1, max 62. build.mjs enforces this and tells you how many characters to trim - it is not advisory. slogan and attribution both accept either a single string or an array of lines, so long copy wraps instead of being cut.
